patches.purpose: Optional no-login persistent browser profile; preserve guest owner IDs before expiry cleanup. Explicit managed/invalid intents fail closed, and restored connection settings do not auto-join document, account or file-sync rooms. No platform identity is synthesized.
patches.removalCondition: Upstream supplies persistent anonymous local profiles, safe pre-cleanup migration and explicit no-upload startup policy with equivalent regressions.
patches.integrationStatus: 45 foundation cases, 13 focused cases, application types/lint and 1043 full regressions passed exact source 52f2fa0 run 38136349644. Real browser profile migration, filesystem writing and explicit optional connection UI remain pending.

patches.purpose: Filename-only bounded serial review of an authorized local folder; choose LaTeX/Typst/Markdown or files-only and a relative entry before creating a project. Recheck permission and entry existence, preserve recoverable project on link failure, skip protected path segments without dropping .gitattributes. No platform binding, source upload or compile trigger in discovery.
patches.removalCondition: Upstream supports generic local folder format/entry review, safe permission/cancellation handling and equivalent project metadata persistence.
patches.integrationStatus: 55 foundation cases, 31 focused cases, application types/lint and 1063 full regressions passed exact source 95d6287 run 38138088522. Native browser directory import, complete binary recovery and disk write acknowledgments remain pending.

patches.purpose: Propagate per-path write/close outcomes through real FileStore mirroring to existing folder controls; preserve source annotations by default in persistent-local mode. Copy queued bytes and targets, serialize writes, reject protected/traversing/duplicate paths, and prevent stale directory/project completions from clearing newer pending input. Count only actually completed writes in folder export activity.
patches.removalCondition: Upstream provides equivalent structured disk-write results, safe queue/target scoping and distinct local-source preservation defaults, with actual caller/UI regressions.
patches.integrationStatus: Connected implementation; application checks in progress. Results are in-memory operation reports, not durable project revisions, snapshot/hash journals or native filesystem read-back certification. External edit/multi-tab protection and recoverable rename/delete remain pending.
